title: A long-term follow-up study for patients treated with Galapagos CAR T cell therapies
official: A long-term follow-up study for patients treated with Galapagos CAR T-cell therapies
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the long-term safety of GLPG CAR T cell products for up to 15 years post CAR T cell product infusion
conditions: Relapsed or refractory Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia (CLL) or Small Lymphocytic Lymphoma (SLL)
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Subject must sign and date the ICF as approved by the Independent Ethics Committee (IEC)/Institutional Review Board (IRB), prior to any study-related procedures.
2. Subjects has been treated with a GLPG CAR T-cell therapy in a clinical trial or Managed Access Program.
Exclusion criteria:
1. There are no exclusion criteria for this study.
